guarantees.claim: edn_req_int is always the bitwise OR of entropy_clearing_req and entropy_masking_req.
entropy_clearing_ack is asserted exactly when entropy_clearing_req is active and edn_ack is active.
entropy_masking_ack is asserted only when entropy_clearing_req is inactive, entropy_masking_req is active, and edn_ack is active; clearing has strict priority.
edn_req is the logical OR of edn_req_int and edn_req_hold_q.
edn_req_hold_d is (edn_req_hold_q OR edn_req) masked by ~edn_ack; it remains high until edn_ack is asserted, holding a request even if the originating req_int drops.

uncertain_points.claim: The edn_req_hold_q register (updated from edn_req_hold_d) must not be reset while a request is outstanding and EDN has not acknowledged, otherwise the hold promise is broken and EDN could be left in a strange state.
uncertain_points.cond: escalation or fatal alert leading to AES reset while edn_req is high and edn_ack is low.
uncertain_points.risk: EDN may see request drop without a handshake completion, potentially hanging or corrupting EDN state, contradicting the intent of the hold logic.

uncertain_points.claim: Combinational ack outputs (entropy_clearing_ack, entropy_masking_ack) may glitch if their input signals transition near the consumer's sampling edge, potentially propagating a false acknowledgment.
uncertain_points.cond: entropy_clearing_req, entropy_masking_req, or edn_ack change close to the capturing clock edge.
uncertain_points.risk: False ack could cause the clearing or masking PRNG to advance or read incorrect entropy, compromising entropy quality or masking integrity.
